title: Outcome tracking: post-delivery critical-defect + field-feedback log
context: Success is measured as outcomes delivered, so a maintained log captures per delivered pack the adoption status, post-delivery Tier-C critical defects (target 0), and field-usability feedback. This feeds the PLAN success metrics. It depends on the first delivery.
objective: Create and maintain the post-delivery outcome log (critical-defects + field feedback) per delivered pack.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintained log capturing, per delivered pack: adoption status, post-delivery Tier-C critical defects (target 0), and field-usability feedback
Structured/validated so entries are consistent and queryable
Updated on each delivery and on any reported field defect
